prompt: Sketch me a wireframe for a user settings page with: a sidebar navigation listing Profile, Security, and Notifications sections. The main area should show the Profile section with name and email inputs, an avatar placeholder, and a Save button.

assertions.text: Uses box-drawing characters (┌ ─ ┐ │ └ ┘ or similar Unicode)
Split panel layout with sidebar and main content area
Sidebar contains Profile, Security, and Notifications items
Profile section is active/selected in sidebar
Main area contains Mockdown text input patterns ([___] or similar)
Contains a Save button using [ Save ] pattern
Output is wrapped in a code fence
